policy.meaning: Both anatomical forward axes face mostly upward and both trunk long axes are mostly horizontal, with pelvis and torso low above actual terrain. Original starts only; no edited poses.

target.target: Terrain-designed supine recovery commands. Each side uses the nearest supported same-start unguided mode as donor; actual outcomes must pass opposite physical-turn and recovery gates.

pose_waypoints.compression: Synthetic command compressed to <=16 original physical-time knots. No exported motion is transformed or retimed.

design.name: supine_early_pose
design.method: Add the requested world-vertical turn minus the donor measured world-vertical turn to each donor orientation and horizontal velocity. Preserve get-up tilt, original timing, movement scale and ground clearance over released terrain. Recompute the synthetic causal heading from the full designed orientation trajectory. This avoids mistaking a supine pitch-induced heading flip for a physical turn. Select among3 angles and3 translation scales using terrain height changes and footprint roughness.
design.limitation: Designed goal, not an observed or guaranteed feasible trajectory. Full body contacts are tested in IsaacSim.

provenance.schedule_changes: None. Exact lane, costs, physical timing and terminal behavior.
provenance.scope: Single-robot MuJoCo/hardware adaptation; original Isaac batch/DR is not reproduced.
